meta.notice: Pre-release template: placeholder figures. Not a costing of the Scottish Budget 2027-28.

basis.gross_or_net: gross cost or yield to the Scottish Government before any block grant adjustment
basis.behaviour: static: no behavioural response unless a measure says so

measures.name: Starter and basic rate thresholds raised
measures.description: Top of the starter band to £17,116 and top of the basic band to £30,559, both held in 2028-29.
measures.basis_note: Measured against thresholds uprated by CPI on the October 2026 forecast.

measures.name: Higher, advanced and top thresholds frozen
measures.description: The higher, advanced and top rate thresholds stay at £43,662, £75,000 and £125,140 to 2028-29.
measures.basis_note: Already current law, so it costs nothing against the baseline.

measures.name: New band before the higher rate
measures.description: A new band between the intermediate and higher rates.

measures.name: Intermediate rate up 1p
measures.basis_note: Static. Official costings include behaviour, so expect this figure to be larger.

measures.name: Scottish property income rates
measures.description: Rates on property income set 2p above the main Scottish rates from 2027-28.

measures.name: Scottish Child Payment raised
measures.description: Scottish Child Payment of £30.00 a week in 2027-28, uprated in 2028-29.
measures.basis_note: Measured against CPI uprating to £29.20 a week, which is already current law.

measures.name: Scottish Child Payment premium for children under one
measures.description: £40 a week for each child under one from 2027-28, uprated in 2028-29.
measures.basis_note: Costed for a full year from April 2027.

measures.name: £100 payment for homes in council tax Bands A to D
measures.description: A one-off £100 for each Scottish household in Bands A to D.
measures.basis_note: Counted in 2027-28; the tax year is to be confirmed.

measures.name: Council tax freeze
measures.description: Council tax bills held flat in cash terms in 2027-28.
measures.basis_note: Council tax is a cost to councils; any Scottish Government funding to councils for the freeze is not modelled.

measures.name: Council tax Bands I and J
measures.description: New bands for homes worth £1m to £2m and over £2m, from April 2028.
measures.reason: No Scottish home in the data is worth over £2m and the model has no Band J, so Bands I and J cannot be costed.

measures.name: Scottish Carer Supplement raised
measures.description: Carer Supplement of £12.50 in 2027-28, uprated in 2028-29.
measures.basis_note: The current-law supplement depends on the model release; the Methodology tab names it.

measures.name: Adult Disability Payment changes
measures.description: Changes to Adult Disability Payment eligibility.
measures.reason: Adult Disability Payment is carried as PIP; a change to ADP rules cannot be applied to the data.

measures.name: Top-up for young parents on Universal Credit
measures.description: A weekly top-up for Universal Credit families with a parent under 25.

measures.name: Benefit cap mitigation
measures.description: Payments that make up the benefit cap reduction for capped families.

measures.name: Additional Dwelling Supplement raised
measures.description: Additional Dwelling Supplement on second homes and buy-to-let purchases from 8% to 10%.
measures.basis_note: Static: the number of purchases does not change. Purchases are modelled, not observed.

measures.name: Air Departure Tax rates
measures.description: Rates of Air Departure Tax on flights from Scotland.
measures.basis_note: Not a household tax in the model; the official costing is recorded.

measures.name: Non-domestic rates poundage and reliefs
measures.basis_note: A business tax, outside the model; the official costing is recorded.
